description: Save a new structured workout to Garmin Connect (then use schedule_workouts to put it on the calendar so it syncs to the watch). Pass exactly one of: `preset` for a standard session from a few parameters (run_intervals, walk_run, easy_z2, strength_circuit); `definition` for anything else (typed steps with duration and target, nestable repeats); `garmin_json` only to copy an existing Garmin workout JSON. Errors name the bad field, e.g. steps[2].steps[0].target. Call with dry_run: true first, show the steps to the user and save only after they agree. dry_run saves nothing and does not contact Garmin: it returns the readable steps and the estimated duration (time steps, plus distance steps at the middle of their pace range; steps with neither are listed in estimate_note, and for garmin_json that carries its own estimate the note says it was taken from there).
